meta.title: Tax Sale Investment Research
meta.disclaimer: Research aid only. A tax lien is not ownership of a property. No listing shown as a bundle without official current documentation. Value estimates require comps and a dated method. This independent research page is not an offer, charitable program, or use of charitable funds.
meta.imagePolicy: Property photographs must be licensed or supplied by authorized auction sources. Google Street View opens on Google Maps; Google imagery is not downloaded or rehosted.
meta.summary: Two verified budget-scale upcoming Roanoke VA two-parcel tax-deed lots (Nov 18, 2026). Nine additional closed 2–3-parcel Michigan tax-foreclosure deed bundles added to historical examples. One unpriced Nov 2026 TN bankruptcy auction remains research only.

investmentCriteria.notes: Prefer affordable genuine bundled acquisition opportunities. Estimated total cost includes minimum bid or portfolio face amount where relevant, fees, taxes, premium and mandatory known costs. Unknown price must be flagged for manual screening, not represented as affordable.

bundles.name: Roanoke Lot N1 — Kennedy Street NE · 2-lot vacant land package
bundles.minimumBidDescription: Auctioneer's displayed starting bid, not final or guaranteed
bundles.auctionType: Nonjudicial delinquent-tax deed sale; two legally separate tax parcels offered as one lot
bundles.summary: Two vacant land parcels near Kennedy Street NE sold together as one N1 auction lot; ~0.4629 acres combined. Auctioneer lists a $200 starting bid, with final bid subject to competition and city approval.
bundles.acquisitionDescription: One two-parcel group offered together for deed conveyance. Total acreage ~0.4629. N1 is nonjudicial; deeds conveyed by special warranty deed subject to record interests.
bundles.depositRule: Full winning bid + buyer premium + deed recording due within seven days of close for online bidder (by Nov 25); for in-person bidders payment due at auction. Confirm final instructions.
bundles.risks: Vacant land with unverified title, access, frontage, buildability, soil and services; seller does not guarantee right of way; special warranty deed, as-is; city may reject bids deemed unreasonable. 10% buyer premium, minimum $150, recording costs and subsequent property taxes additional. Auction listings are not evidence of market value or zoning eligibility.

bundles.depositRule: Full winning bid, buyer premium and deed recording due within seven days of close for online bidder; confirm auctioneer's currently posted N8 terms.
bundles.risks: Very small combined area (~0.0451 acre) may be non-buildable; verify legal access and ability to use separately or together. archiveExamples.note: Vacant-lot deed bundle. Catalog title says 114 parcels, but detailed list enumerates 115; reconcile before any future offer. Current taxes shown $17,397.61. Closed 30 October 2026; advertised minimum no longer available.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8799 · Genesee demolition bundle
archiveExamples.note: Tax-foreclosed property bundle with demolition and performance-bond requirements. Title says 198 but detailed list enumerates 199. Current-year taxes shown $182,849.97 in addition to minimum. Closed 30 October 2026; major liability and occupancy concerns.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 5446 · Liberty Street vacant-land bundle

archiveExamples.name: Lot 5448 · Washington Street vacant-land bundle

archiveExamples.note: Closed two-parcel tax-foreclosure sale involving a single-story home with multiple garages. Historical minimum only, NOT current price. Parcel 2 appears to contain a building. Condition, title and right of access unverified.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 1910 · Harrison house and outbuilding parcels
archiveExamples.note: Closed two-parcel tax-foreclosure auction comprising single-story structure/outbuildings. Second parcel lacks a public street address. Minimum bid does not include current taxes and closing fees.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 6808 · Two lots on unimproved Jaywood Drive
archiveExamples.note: Closed two-parcel bundle of ~0.24 acres on an unimproved road near Silverwood. Very low accessibility and development confidence. Parcel records list no conventional numbered address.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8459 · Fenton Road former liquor store plus vacant lot
archiveExamples.note: Closed tax-foreclosed grouped commercial structure and second vacant parcel in Flint. Historical minimum $9,792 plus current taxes; liquor license is NOT assumed included. Building, code, environmental and use restrictions must be assessed.

archiveExamples.note: Closed two-parcel tax-foreclosure group of ~0.75 acres near Grass Lake; cottage present. The official catalog alternately showed current tax to be announced; don't assume none. Verify access and water exposure.

researchLeads.name: Hidden Valley Lakes — Ten Multi-Parcel Packages
researchLeads.category: Court-ordered bankruptcy deed auction — NOT tax sale
researchLeads.location: 0 Hidden Valley Road, Hidden Valley Lakes, Nunnelly, TN 37137
researchLeads.note: Court-ordered absolute bankruptcy sale of 100 recreational/residential parcels offered in ten separate packages. Auctioneer says highest bidders win regardless of price; NOT a tax sale. Individual package boundaries, parcel IDs and current bids were not visible in the public page; do NOT assume each package is ten parcels or affordable.
researchLeads.risks: Unverified package-level prices and parcel descriptions, possible subdivision restrictions and assessments, rural access, unverified buildability, no contingencies, 10% buyer premium, 10% earnest deposit, closing 30 days or within 15 days of court approval. Buyer must inspect full property information package.
researchLeads.qualifier: Research lead only, not approved as within budget. Do not convert to verified active affordable bundle until each package's parcels, acquisition cost and legal terms are verified.
